query:
SELECT key_id, sequence_number, pks_key,
                   CASE WHEN $1 THEN sks_key
                        ELSE COALESCE(compressed_xof_keyset, sks_key)
                   END AS "server_key_blob!",
                   CASE WHEN $1 THEN FALSE
                        ELSE compressed_xof_keyset IS NOT NULL
                   END AS "is_xof!",
                   cks_key
                   FROM keys
